entities.name: Irencrag
entities.description: Magical boulder in Embereth glowing with volcanic heat; central to the knighting ritual and able to give swords legendary names.

entities.name: Embereth
entities.description: Eldraine realm where the Irencrag stands.

entities.name: Ianthe
entities.description: Knight said to have started the ritual by impaling the Irencrag.

entities.name: Embercleave
entities.description: Legendary sword created through the Irencrag.

events.summary: Aspiring knights plunge swords into the Irencrag as a test of courage.
events.quote: An aspiring knight would plunged their sword into the Irencrag as a test of courage

events.summary: Ianthe impaled the Irencrag after it taunted her, per legend.
events.quote: this ritual originated with the knight Ianthe, who impaled the Irencrag after it taunted her

relations.note: Empowers worthy knights' swords with legendary names, leading to Embercleave
relations.quote: This led to the creation of the Embercleave .
